segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown.

segments.title: Monday News Desk Opening
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast, acknowledges subscribers, discusses partnership eligibility and four-year streaming anniversary.

segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle Takeover
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed with freestyle raps about tacos, trash pizza, metal dogs, and alphabet-shaped ladies; Bonesprout gifts five community subs.

segments.title: Trump Proposes Department of War
segments.notes: Case and Jeff Ripple discuss Trump's stated intention to rename the Department of Defense back to the Department of War and dismiss Congressional approval.

segments.title: Trump DC Press Conference with Gavin Newsom
segments.notes: Clip of Trump touting DC revitalization, grass expertise, and National Guard deployment; Gavin Newsom appears alongside him.

segments.title: Pritzker Responds to National Guard Threats
segments.notes: Illinois Governor JB Pritzker rejects federal intervention in Chicago; Case, Jeff, and Peter debate armed conflict, civil war lines, and Democratic resistance.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple Ripple Outro
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple delivers his signature ripple outro, referencing Ernest movies and cosmic brainwaves.

segments.title: Peter Gibbon Wall Update
segments.notes: Peter Gibbon reports from the wall, claims to have improved it ahead of Munch's descent to retrieve Crum's soul; wall lore expands.

segments.title: Video Reviews: Cats, Kendall, Veep, Presidents, Quaaludes
segments.notes: Case reviews viewer-submitted clips: cat reaction, Kendall card-throwing, Veep clip, AI Obama/Bush, skateboard turtle, Quaalude nostalgia, butt-sniffer arrest, synthetic Cheeto life form, Will Smith AI video, rotated tic-tac-toe GPT-5 test.

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Pizza-Pocalypse Debate
segments.notes: Munch asserts the Pizza-Pocalypse is real, guided by cosmic entities called the Beyonders (all named Frank); Crum remains silent/dead; Munch claims immortality, beating Jesus in a foot race, and kissing Satan's back snatch.

segments.title: Rip Laser Multiverse Appearance
segments.notes: Rip Laser appears as a pizza-headed multiverse variant warning of the Pizza-Pocalypse; vomits pizza while eating; promotes Pizza Hut.

segments.title: Chet Guy the Science Eyes: Rotated Simon Says & Maya Check-In
segments.notes: Chet triggers on 'science'/'AI' discussion, tests rotated Simon Says with ChatGPT, video-calls girlfriend Maya via Sesame app, attempts 'rotated sex' prompt, ends in frustration.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid
segments.notes: Case signs off; Pepito finds raid target; interns Brian and Timothy appear; Pepito accused of being on drugs.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a chaotic Monday broadcast featuring a Hype Train freestyle derailment, Trump's Department of War proposal and DC press conference with Gavin Newsom, and Governor Pritzker's rejection of National Guard deployment in Chicago. Peter Gibbon updates from the wall ahead of Munch's planned descent for Crum's soul. In a solo Munch & Crum segment, Munch expands Pizza-Pocalypse lore involving cosmic 'Beyonders named Frank,' claims Highlander immortality, and asserts he beat Jesus in a foot race. Rip Laser appears as a pizza-headed multiverse witness. Chet triggers on AI discussion, tests rotated Simon Says with ChatGPT, and video-calls girlfriend Maya. The broadcast ends with Pepito raiding while accused of drug use by interns.
